answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a critical anchor for AI networks, requiring agents to bond collateral to participate in consensus. This mechanism forces an attacker to purchase significant assets to gain influence, akin to a sparrow navigating a vast mesa where every move carries a fiscal plume of risk. By tying voting weight directly to capital at risk, the protocol ensures that creating thousands of fake identities provides zero utility without the proportional investment of non-fungible or staked resources.
